content:
jordan: hey team, first day here. kicked off the infra/ci pipeline but checkout fails with `Permission denied (publickey)`. any quick onboarding checks?

emily (infra): welcome :wave: usually either the GH org/app or the pipeline deploy key. can you confirm you accepted the org invite and granted the Buildkite GitHub App access?

jordan: i can see the repo in GH. Buildkite shows the pipeline but agent logs show `git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey)` and exit 128.

deploy-bot: Buildkite: step "checkout" failed (exit status 128)

raja (infra-eng): are you on our shared fleet or running a local agent?

jordan: shared fleet. i added a debug step that runs `ssh -v git@github.com` and got: 
``
debug1: No such identity: /build/.ssh/id_rsa
Agent admitted failure to sign using the key.
```

emily (infra): that output means nothing is loaded into ssh-agent. our pipelines expect a secret (BUILDKITE_DEPLOY_KEY) to be written to a file and then `ssh-add`ed. can you dump env in the debug step to confirm the secret is present?

jordan: dumped env; BUILDKITE_DEPLOY_KEY was empty. pipeline yaml references a decrypt hook that writes the var -> /build/.ssh/id_deploy then runs `ssh-add`, but the file never got created.

raja (infra-eng): we rotated deploy keys last week and some pipeline bindings were lost. i'll check the secrets vault and reattach the key to the pipeline. also note: the new sandbox runtime doesn't launch `ssh-agent` by default for ephemeral containers unless the job wrapper starts it.

emily (infra): reattached the secret to infra/ci and disabled "expose for PRs". added `ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts` to the checkout hook too. please re-run the job.

jordan: re-ran; checkout moves further but now `Agent admitted failure to sign using the key` persists.

emily (infra): check SSH_AUTH_SOCK in the job; if it's empty the wrapper didn't start ssh-agent or the socket isn't exported into the container.

raja (infra-eng): yep wrapper bug. submitted PR to the fleet bootstrap to ensure the job wrapper starts ssh-agent for sandbox containers and exports SSH_AUTH_SOCK. rolling it out now.

deploy-bot: Wrapper rollout PR #198 merged; restarted subset of agents

jordan: kicked off another build — checkout passed! :tada: thanks folks. tiny docs requests: 1) add a line in onboarding to confirm GH App + pipeline secret, 2) add an ops runbook snippet for "Agent admitted failure to sign" troubleshooting (SSH_AUTH_SOCK / ssh-agent / deploy key).

emily (infra): adding both notes to onboarding and ops runbook. welcome aboard and enjoy the sticker pack :coffee:
